title: Feels good to finally make progress
body:
Each year I make new year resolutions and find that by March I have forgotten them or moved on to the next pressing thing. Even using reminders in calendar to review progress quarterly didn't help much. That is why this year I went hunting for a way to change my habits. That's right habits; not just goals. I read a lot of reviews and tested several apps but Strides comes up top. 

The free app has so much stuff you don't even need to pay for the premium features. It is easy to use and has such easy ways of tracking progress. It uses gentle reminders and nudges when you are falling behind. Best part is that it tracks goals (the desired end result), milestones (markers along the way) and even habits (to see that the behavior sticks). Some goals are really tough to keep but with Strides I find swiping a completed target rather fulfilling. 

Try it out for yourself, you'll be pleasantly surprised.

title: Great app!
body:
I liked this app so much. It helps me a lot in tracking my progress toward achieving my goals. Goals give our lives a purpose and meaning. I loved the fact that I could use a lot of features for free. Personally I would go for the paid version later because it offers us an opportunity to save our finished projects and goals as a good reminder of our successes.

I highly recommend this app because it teaches people how to plan for achievable goals.
